ocr.markdown:
Recipe: Cheese Ball
From the Kitchen of: DR
2 - 8oz cream cheese
1 c. shredded cheddar cheese
1 TBSP chopped piments
1 tsp. lemon juice
1 TBSP chopped green pepper
1 tsp. worcestershire sauce
1 TBSP chopped onion
Soften cream cheese - mix ingred. well -
form in ball or log + roll in almonds.
(wax paper)
